answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a quadratic-signalling stake: every agent locks a bond that grows with the square of its claimed voting weight. To pose as N identities, an attacker must post N separate bonds, so influence costs quadratic, not linear, capital. Peers who catch a duplicate slash the cheater's entire bond and split it with the reporter, turning a mesa of sock-puppets into a losing wager. Honest agents leave a crystal audit trail, while violet marks flag suspected clusters for review.
